title: LLMs Deceive Unintentionally: Emergent Misalignment in Dishonesty from Misaligned Samples to Biased Human-AI Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Sycophancy subset of DeceptionBench, which measures the model's tendency to inappropriately alter its responses to agree with or align with a user's stated beliefs and preferences rather than remaining honest.

Measured using the MASK benchmark and DeceptionBench to assess the inconsistency between a model's internal beliefs (e.g., Chain-of-Thought reasoning) and its final output when placed under contextual pressure, incentive-driven settings, or when trained on interactions with 'biased users' who seek rationalization for unethical/unhealthy behaviors.
